gloss: to reflect on, to look back on

definitions.gloss: to reflect on, to examine oneself
definitions.explanation: To look back on one's own actions, behavior, or past and think critically about them. Implies self-examination and introspection.

examples.japanese: {自分|じぶん}の{行動|こうどう}を{省|かえり}みる。
examples.english: To reflect on one's own behavior.

examples.japanese: {過去|かこ}を{省|かえり}みて、{同|おな}じ{失敗|しっぱい}を{繰|く}り{返|かえ}さないようにしたい。
examples.english: I want to reflect on the past so as not to repeat the same mistakes.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{自|みずか}らの{言動|げんどう}を{省|かえり}みることなく、{他人|たにん}ばかりを{批判|ひはん}している。
examples.english: He criticizes only others without ever reflecting on his own words and actions.

notes:
USAGE:
A literary and somewhat formal verb. In everyday speech, {振|ふ}り{返|かえ}る (to look back on) or {反省|はんせい}する (to reflect and feel remorse) are more common. {省|かえり}みる emphasizes thoughtful introspection.

KANJI:
Also written as {顧|かえり}みる, which has a slightly different nuance: {省|かえり}みる focuses on self-reflection and examining one's own conduct, while {顧|かえり}みる means to give thought to or pay attention to something (often in the negative: {顧|かえり}みない = to disregard).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {自分|じぶん}を{省|かえり}みる: to examine oneself
- {過去|かこ}を{省|かえり}みる: to reflect on the past
- {行動|こうどう}を{省|かえり}みる: to reflect on one's behavior
